revised_comments: Cape Verde's tax and customs authority (DNRE) has digitalised the majority of revenue collection under its Digital Tax and Customs Reform (RTAD++) programme, including online payment of the Single Collection Document (DUC), instalment payments, electronic customs duties and e-invoicing (e-Fatura). Taxpayers can settle income tax, VAT and customs obligations through DNRE's online portal and mobile application, with amounts due typically settled through partner commercial banks or the Post Office.

revised_comments: Cape Verde disburses government-to-person payments digitally through several channels: the Rendimento Social de Inclusão (RSI) cash transfer programme pays beneficiaries by electronic fund transfer directly into bank accounts, administered by the National Centre for Social Pensions (CNPS); and the non-contributory Social Pension can also be received via the SISP-certified Makeba mobile money application. These arrangements represent active, if not yet universal, use of digital rails for social transfers and pensions.

These provisions sit alongside the general electronic money and payment institution regime established by Decretos-Legislativos n.º 7 to 9/2018.

Both requirements apply to payment service providers processing personal and transaction data.
